windowsBinarySources.notes: Official PostGIS 3.7.0 page (checked 2026-11-13) lists released Windows installers for PG18-19, PG15-17 installers forthcoming, and additional binaries under Unreleased Versions. A separately audited PG18 3.7.0 original ZIP is only a pinned candidate: source-to-binary producer provenance, complete dependency/NOTICE rights and formal pgextwin download authorization remain unverified.
